card.name: The verb explain in scientific accounts
card.fires_on: The word explain, explained or explanation when a finding or result is said to be accounted for by a mechanism. It appears mostly in scientific or research prose after can, could be, or to.

modes.label: Explain after modal or to
modes.description: Explain or explained follows can, could be, to, or be, as in a result being accounted for by a cause.
modes.example: can only be<< explained>> if there is quantum mechanical mixing

card.plain: It marks the word explain when a paper says a result can or cannot be accounted for by some cause.
